    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{
  "result": [
    { "value": "", "msg": "", "error": "" }
  ]
}'
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @action INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures')
    );

    DECLARE @payload TABLE (
        leadCaptureId            INT NULL,
        fullName                 NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        email                    NVARCHAR(150) NULL,
        companyName              NVARCHAR(200) NULL,
        phone                    NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        jobTitle                 NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        message                  NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        leadSource               NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        interestArea             NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        status                   NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        assignedTo               INT NULL,
        privacyConsentAccepted   BIT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        leadCaptureId,
        fullName,
        email,
        companyName,
        phone,
        jobTitle,
        message,
        leadSource,
        interestArea,
        status,
        assignedTo,
        privacyConsentAccepted
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadCaptureId')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.fullName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.email'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.companyName'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.phone'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.jobTitle'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.message'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.leadSource'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.interestArea'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.status'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.assignedTo')),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.privacyConsentAccepted'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.leadCaptures');

    IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicate normalized emails within the payload itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload
            GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(email))
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate normalized email entries within the payload.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.leadCaptures (
            fullName,
            email,
            companyName,
            phone,
            jobTitle,
            message,
            leadSource,
            interestArea,
            status,
            assignedTo,
            privacyConsentAccepted,
            created_At
        )
        SELECT
            p.fullName,
            p.email,
            p.companyName,
            p.phone,
            p.jobTitle,
            p.message,
            p.leadSource,
            p.interestArea,
            ISNULL(p.status, 'new'), -- Default 'new' if not provided
            p.assignedTo,
            p.privacyConsentAccepted,
            GETDATE()
        FROM @payload p;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicate normalized emails within the payload, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload p_inner
            GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(p_inner.email))
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate normalized email entries within the payload for update.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.normalizedEmail = LOWER(TRIM(p.email))
            WHERE lc.leadCaptureId <> p.leadCaptureId
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Lead with this normalized email already exists.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        UPDATE lc
        SET
            fullName                 = ISNULL(p.fullName, lc.fullName),
            email                    = ISNULL(p.email, lc.email),
            companyName              = ISNULL(p.companyName, lc.companyName),
            phone                    = ISNULL(p.phone, lc.phone),
            jobTitle                 = ISNULL(p.jobTitle, lc.jobTitle),
            message                  = ISNULL(p.message, lc.message),
            leadSource               = ISNULL(p.leadSource, lc.leadSource),
            interestArea             = ISNULL(p.interestArea, lc.interestArea),
            status                   = ISNULL(p.status, lc.status),
            assignedTo               = ISNULL(p.assignedTo, lc.assignedTo),
            privacyConsentAccepted   = ISNULL(p.privacyConsentAccepted, lc.privacyConsentAccepted),
            updated_at               = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId
        WHERE p.leadCaptureId IS NOT NULL;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE
    BEGIN
        DELETE lc
        FROM dbo.leadCaptures lc
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON lc.leadCaptureId = p.leadCaptureId
        WHERE p.leadCaptureId IS NOT NULL;
    END

    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

Finish:
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');
END CATCH
